card.name: The word View in web text
card.fires_on: The word "view" (or "View"), often capitalized, in web page text. It appears as a link or button label, or as the second half of a compound like OpenView or Print View.

modes.label: Interface link
modes.description: "View" as a button or link label, or the end of a compound like Print View or OpenView.
modes.example: |Skip Navigation Links| |Exit Print<< View>>| |Oracle Solaris Administration: Z

modes.label: Noun in a phrase
modes.description: "view" as a noun meaning a picture or outlook, after a word like close-up, Christian or unprecedented.
modes.example: Close-up<< View>> of Vesta's South Pole Region

card.plain: It fires on the word "view", both as a website link label and as an ordinary noun.
